title: Interactive — ikki tomonlama I/O
measures: interactive checker HALI YOZILMAGAN — sandbox nosozligi emas
source:
import sys
lo, hi = 1, 100
while lo < hi:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    print(mid, flush=True)
    r = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if r == "<": hi = mid
    elif r == ">": lo = mid + 1
    else: break
print("!", lo, flush=True)
